Container.Name: lore-webgui
Container.Overview:
A web interface for Lore, the open source version control system from Epic Games. Browse repositories, history, files and diffs. Compare branches, see file locks, and create repositories and branches. Open pages update when someone pushes.
You need a running Lore Server. The Lore Server template in this repository sets one up.
Set Lore Server host to the IP or host name of your Lore Server. If it runs on this Unraid server, use your Unraid IP. Do not use localhost: inside the container, it points to the container itself. Clone commands in the web UI also show this address.
The web UI connects to the Lore Server on port 41337 for gRPC and port 41339 for file content. If you changed those host ports, add the variables LORE_GRPC_URL and LORE_HTTP_URL, such as http://[your Unraid IP]:41337.
First start: open the container's log and copy the setup code. Open the web UI, paste the code, and create the admin account. The admin adds other people on the Users page. Viewers browse. Members also create repositories and branches. Admins also manage users.
To show who created each branch and repository, set Trust unsigned identity to true in the Lore Server template. Without it, Lore records web UI actions as <unknown>.
The Data folder holds the accounts database. Back it up to keep your accounts.
Keep the web UI on your LAN. Do not forward its port. Accounts protect the web UI only. Anyone who can reach the Lore Server can still use the lore CLI. For access from outside, use a VPN.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Accounts database. Without it, accounts are lost each time the container is updated.

Config.Name: Lore Server host
Config.Description: IP or host name of your Lore Server, such as 192.168.1.10. If it runs on this Unraid server, use your Unraid IP. Not localhost.

Config.Name: Lore token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty unless your Lore Server requires sign-in. Every signed-in person uses this token, so give it the least access that works. Lore then records the token's name, not each person's.

Config.Name: Sign-in
Config.Description: accounts requires sign-in. off gives everyone full access, with no sign-in. Use off only behind a reverse proxy that signs people in.

Config.Name: Max diff size
Config.Description: Files larger than this many bytes show no diff. 2097152 is 2 MiB.

Config.Name: History concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel revision lookups for each page of history.
